name: Globally coupled bistable units with Gaussian diversity
question: How accurately does the population follow a weak bias when it is swept through its collective threshold, for N units and a given sweep rate?
assumptions: eq. (1) of the source without the periodic forcing; the coupling C swept through C* = 1.358 at the diversity sigma = 1 (above sigma_c = 0.757 at C = 1)
an independent thermal noise D = 0.01 on every unit (the source neglects noise)

provenance.source: C. J. Tessone, C. R. Mirasso, R. Toral and J. D. Gunton, Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 194101 (2006)
